summary: Iteration 16 — Full validation of the new mandatory OTP + T&Cs signup flow (backend + frontend). Backend: 17/18 pytest tests pass on the new /api/auth/register, /otp/*, /google/finalize and /me endpoints via preview URL. Frontend: signup wizard, session persistence, login-to-Home redirect, no-Skip, and under-18 gate all verified end-to-end.

minor.issue: Cloudflare/ingress is injecting Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and no Access-Control-Allow-Credentials on the OPTIONS response, ahead of/instead of the FastAPI CORSMiddleware's echoed origin. On real GET responses BOTH 'ACAO: *' (from ingress) AND 'Allow-Credentials: true' (from FastAPI) are present — a spec-invalid combination that browsers may reject for cookie-credentialed requests. In practice the preview app uses JWT in Authorization header (not cookies) so requests succeed, which is why iteration_15 and this run both saw the app working. Only mentioned as a preview-infra observation — user already flagged this is a prod-only symptom.

The Twilio-bypass mechanism (TEST_OTP_BYPASS_CODE=000000) is only wired inside _verify_twilio_otp() which is called from /register and /google/finalize. login-verify calls client.verify.v2.services(...).verification_checks.create() DIRECTLY with no bypass hook, so tests using bypass code cannot exercise the phone-login path end-to-end. Passed 400 gracefully; would benefit from being routed through the same helper for consistency.

action_items: Batch-update the following legacy backend tests that POST to /api/auth/register with the OLD signature (email/name/password only) and now hard-fail with 422 or 500: test_profile.py (7 tests), test_wallet.py (all tests via fixture), test_referrals.py (all tests), test_stripe_payments.py, test_games.py, test_games_v2.py, test_checkout_wallet.py, test_scheduler_notifications.py. They must include phone, otp_code='000000', accept_terms=True, dob='2000-08-02' in the register payload. NOTE: per user instructions I did NOT modify these files.
(Optional) Route /api/auth/otp/login-verify through the same _verify_twilio_otp helper so the TEST_OTP_BYPASS_CODE works there too — currently blocks automated E2E of the phone-login tab.

(Optional / infra) Preview URL responses have duplicate CORS headers: Cloudflare/ingress injects 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' while FastAPI CORSMiddleware also echoes credentialed headers. This is invalid per spec when Allow-Credentials is true. The app works today only because it uses JWT (Authorization header) not cookies. If any endpoint ever needs cookie auth from the browser, request will be blocked by browsers.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_routes.py:_generate_username uses linear scan `for i in range(1,1000)` with N Mongo find_one round-trips — fine for MVP but O(N) per signup at scale. Consider a unique index on `username` and a `findOneAndUpdate` counter document, or single-shot uuid suffix on collision (already the fallback). Not blocking.

auth_routes.py:_verify_twilio_otp bypass is short-circuited BEFORE `_normalize_phone` for the second branch — actually it IS after normalize (line 64). Good. But the bypass check `bypass and code == bypass` uses `==` on strings — fine. Consider using `secrets.compare_digest` for constant-time compare in case bypass is ever enabled in prod by mistake.

twilio_routes.py:login_via_otp duplicates the Twilio verify code that _verify_twilio_otp already implements — refactor to reuse the helper (same helper would also give it TEST_OTP_BYPASS_CODE support). ~15 lines of DRY win.

SignupWizard.jsx step 3 does client-only length check on the 6-digit code and advances to step 4 optimistically (verification happens at /register). This is fine UX, but a stale 6-digit code will only fail on the very last step — worth adding a resend affordance in the step-4 error toast if the failure reason is 'code' (already partially handled by `if (/code/i.test(detail)) setStep(3)` — good).

AuthCallback.jsx line 30: `window.history.replaceState(null, '', '/')` rewrites the URL bar to '/' but the component itself doesn't navigate. If the user hits Back after Google login without finalizing, this creates a confusing history entry. Minor UX polish.

GoogleFinalizeModal has NO close-button (`[&>button]:hidden`), which is the intended 'no skip' behaviour — good. It is also `onEscapeKeyDown/onInteractOutside/onPointerDownOutside preventDefault` — solid.
Legacy test files under /app/backend/tests/ still expect the old register signature — a plumbing/regression risk that needs to be batched by the main agent in a single sweep.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — this iteration is a feature-verification pass, not a bug hunt. Root findings: (1) the new register/google-finalize endpoints, username auto-gen, T&Cs gate, 18+ gate, dup-email, dup-phone, wrong-OTP, and session persistence all work correctly. (2) The preview URL's CORS response is malformed (duplicate/wildcard ACAO alongside Allow-Credentials: true) — this is the same class of issue the user described as the prod session-persistence bug, but here it's the ingress/Cloudflare rewriting the FastAPI response. In preview the JWT+localStorage flow works because the browser doesn't need cookies. On the prod domain (prizeleague.co.uk) the ingress may not inject the wildcard, allowing the FastAPI-echoed origin to reach the browser — worth verifying in prod separately. (3) test_auth_signup.py::TestCors failures are documenting this ingress-injected wildcard, not a bug in server.py — server.py correctly configures allow_origin_regex.
